description: This file defines the One2OneRelationship class, which models a one-to-one relationship within the SuiteCRM framework. It extends M2MRelationship and provides methods for establishing such relationships, including handling existing links to enforce the one-to-one constraint.

classes.name: One2OneRelationship
classes.description: Represents a one-to-one relationship type in the SuiteCRM system, providing logic to manage such relationships and enforce constraints.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the relationship with provided definition, calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new one-to-one relationship between two SugarBean objects, removing existing links from both sides to maintain the one-to-one constraint.
